<title
    level="1"
    right="Item 6"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Cloud Pouch](/Equipment.aspx?ID=3018)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=644" />
<trait label="Water" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=732" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 273

**Price** 225 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 1 hand

**Bulk** 1
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This small bag is filled with a fine, silvery powder that feels silky to the touch. 

**Activate—Disprese** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You scatter the dust into the air around you, causing it to condense into a cloud in a 20-foot burst within 10 feet, as the [_mist_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1606) spell. You can Sustain the activation to make the cloud Fly 20 feet. The cloud lasts 1 minute, and you can Dismiss it.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>
